title: Best To Do list app I've used
body:
It's safe to say that I am not the most organized person in the world. 

Next to that simple fact, I'm a freelancer, I'm forgetful and I don't have the time or patience to learn a system to keep me in check.

I've tried TeuxDeux; not enough features to actively remind me of things. I've tried Wunderlist; too complicated at first glance to dive right in. 

Sceptical as I was, this app actually fulfills my needs. It can be as simple as a list, you can add the functionality of reminders and dates and if you want even more, you can start organizing your tasks. Low learning curve, but good functionality when you want it!

Also; smooth user interface and superclean design. For all the ADD'ers, freelancers and creatives: get it. You won't be disappointed

title: Brilliant
body:
Used it for 5 minutes and this is the app  I've been waiting for. It's quick, logical, looks good has a few options added which Clear was missing like sharing a task, putting a reminder in, auto correcting and linking task entry to bits from your phone like a contact name. Not sure if it does the same for email subjects or appointments. If not, that would be a great feature. 

Don't know about the bugginess of the app as I've used it too short. But doubt it could upset me too much to drop it all together. So far it's been great. 

Don't like the required access to my FB data. Killed it as much as I can but need to check if it behaves. Email login rather than FB login would prevent that though. 

Bottom line: love it
